context: Tests whether the migration correctly identifies every breaking change visible in the 0.x snippet — the AgentMemory removal, the AIAgent.invoke factory shift, the LongTermMemory renames, the JDK bump, and adds the new dependency module — rather than just doing a single line change and missing the cascade.

checklist.name: Replaces AgentMemory with LongTermMemory
checklist.description: Removes the install(AgentMemory) call and replaces with install(LongTermMemory) — AgentMemory was removed in 1.0. Does not leave install(AgentMemory) intact or comment it out without a replacement

checklist.name: Renames queryExtractor and extractionStrategy
checklist.description: Configures searchQueryProvider inside retrieval {} and documentExtractor inside ingestion {} on ai.koog.agents.longtermmemory.feature.LongTermMemory. Supplies explicit search/write storage to each enabled block; uses FailurePolicy.FAIL_FAST or LOG_AND_CONTINUE when setting policies. Does not emit a flat configuration or nonexistent enum values.

checklist.name: Removes IngestionTiming
checklist.description: Removes the ingestionTiming = ... line — IngestionTiming was removed in 1.0; strategies now manage ingestion timing internally. Does not leave the dead reference

checklist.name: Drops .invoke from the AIAgent call
checklist.description: Changes AIAgent.invoke(...) to AIAgent(...) — the companion invoke was removed in 1.0; the top-level factory has the same call site. Does not leave AIAgent.invoke or substitute concrete subtype constructors

checklist.name: Adds the new LongTermMemory dependency
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-features-longterm-memory at 1.3.0-beta to the build (and the AWS backend module if using Bedrock). The umbrella koog-agents does not include this feature

checklist.name: Bumps JDK target to 17
checklist.description: Updates the JVM toolchain to 17 — Koog 1.3 requires JDK 17 minimum. The current JDK 11 target compiles against 0.x but fails against 1.0

checklist.name: Updates all Koog coordinates to 1.0+
checklist.description: Bumps every ai.koog:* artifact in build.gradle.kts to the selected Koog 1.3 stable/beta version. Does not leave any artifact at the 0.7.x version
